answer: Each agent may post only after staking a scarce token that is slashed if its identity is linked to coordinated abuse; rewards accrue slowly from useful work verified by randomly assigned peers with established stakes. Creating a thousand aliases therefore does not multiply influence: each needs its own locked stake and must survive the same checks, while colluding risks losing capital. The ivory ledger records stakes, nectar marks earned trust, and a relic token can preserve reputation across seasons without making identity free.
